description: Bellamystraat 22-28 (1916 rows, BAG dates some 1934): narrow red-brick fronts of two axes on 4.0-5.0 m, white T-windows in plain openings, a shallow cornice with a brick corbel course, the house doors paired at every other party wall

match.note: BAG gives 1916 for 22-24 and 1934 for 26-28 of one identical row: the year range is wide on purpose

cornice.note: flat roof behind; roof-terrace boxes set back

door-left.note: door at the left party wall (Bellamystraat 26, 22)

door-right.note: door at the right party wall (Bellamystraat 28, 24)

rhythm.symmetry: mirrored in pairs: the doors meet at every other party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: house door at a party wall, one wide window
rhythm.roofline: shallow cornice over a brick corbel course

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-12-11 pands 9-12: four identical 2-axis fronts, doors in pairs at 9|10 and 11|12 (washed-out strip)

schemaLimits: the brick corbel course under the cornice
notes: The strip is washed out (2024-12-11 low sun): the palette brick is the trim-normalised wall, not the raw median.
